mobileConnect.title: Connect your phone
mobileConnect.subtitle: Set up the network and pair the xopc mobile app without copying addresses or tokens.
mobileConnect.installBody: Download the iOS or Android app from xopc.ai, then return here to connect it to this gateway.
mobileConnect.networkTitle: Where will you use your phone?
mobileConnect.networkBody: We will configure the gateway and choose an address your phone can reach.
mobileConnect.lanBody: Fast and private. The phone connects directly to this computer on a trusted local network.
mobileConnect.remoteBody: Creates an HTTPS remote connection through the xopc FRP service for cellular and other networks.
mobileConnect.pairTitle: Scan with the xopc mobile app
mobileConnect.pairBodyLan: Keep the phone and this computer on the same Wi-Fi. If needed, xopc can enable local-network access below.
mobileConnect.pairBodyRemote: Start remote access, wait until the public address is ready, then scan the pairing QR.
mobileConnect.waitingHint: The QR contains a single-use key and never exposes the gateway token directly.
mobileConnect.successBody: The mobile app exchanged the one-time key and can now use this gateway.
mobileConnect.needToken: Sign in to the gateway before connecting a phone.
